verdict.rationale: Bitwarden ships an official, first-party CLI (`bw`) that its docs describe as fully featured for accessing and managing the vault. It supports personal-API-key authentication for automated workflows and a `bw serve` local REST mode that agents can query. A runtime probe confirmed it installs from npm (@bitwarden/cli) and runs, and community users report running it hands-on. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of agent-friendly scripting ergonomics (e.g., documented structured-output and non-interactive flags) beyond the summary-level doc excerpts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Bitwarden command-line interface (CLI) is a powerful, fully-featured tool for accessing and managing your vault.
Using the personal API key for CLI authentication is suitable for automated workflows
the official bw CLI installs keylessly from npm (@bitwarden/cli, registry latest 2026.8.0) and prints its version
